name: Emailing your users
summary: Send the emails your app has to send, with a provider you can change and a development mode that never emails a real person.

provenance.source: SimpleHire — its email service, in particular the safety catch that refuses to send to real addresses outside production
provenance.changes: Rewritten behind a small provider interface so the vendor is one line rather than a rewrite, and given a console provider that is the default until a key is set.

env.name: EMAIL_PROVIDER
env.description: Which service sends your email. Leave it as console until you have an account.

env.name: EMAIL_API_KEY
env.description: The key from your email provider.

env.name: EMAIL_FROM
env.description: The address your emails come from. It has to be one your provider has verified.

env.name: EMAIL_ALLOWLIST
env.description: Outside production, only these addresses can be emailed. Comma separated.

extensionPoints.description: Your emails. This file is yours to edit.

postInstall: Until you set EMAIL_API_KEY, emails are printed to the console instead of sent. That is deliberate.
When you are ready, sign up with an email provider and verify the address you want to send from.
limitations: Sends one email at a time. Not a newsletter tool.
No delivery tracking, opens or bounces — those come from the provider's own dashboard.
The Resend provider is written against their documented API and has not been run against a live account here.
